title.zh: 对未来的一个赌注，怎么可能有“公道价”
title.en: How Can a Bet on the Future Have a Fair Price?

desc.zh: 没人知道一年后的股价，期权却每天有成千上万笔按差不多的价格成交。这篇从“远期价不是预测”讲起，一步步走到二叉树、几何布朗运动、布莱克–斯科尔斯公式和它的偏微分方程、希腊字母与对冲，再看它在哪里失灵：波动率微笑、肥尾、保证金与清算，最后是 2026 年 11 月的市场现状。十三个可以动手的模型，只讲数学和市场结构，不是投资建议。
desc.en: Nobody knows next year's share price, yet options on it trade thousands of times a day at nearly the same price. This essay starts from "a forward price is not a forecast" and climbs through the binomial tree, geometric Brownian motion, the Black–Scholes formula and its partial differential equation, the Greeks and hedging, then shows where it fails: the volatility smile, fat tails, margin and clearing, and the state of the market in November 2026. Thirteen hands-on models. Mathematics and market structure only; not investment advice.

title.en: Forward price and cost of carry

desc.zh: 远期价格等于现货价加上持有到期的净成本 F = S·e^((r−q)T)，与任何人对未来的预测无关；偏离它就有无风险套利。
desc.en: A forward price is the spot price plus the net cost of carrying the asset, F = S·e^((r−q)T), whatever anyone forecasts; any other price allows a riskless arbitrage.

zh: 期货价格是不是对未来的预测
en: is the futures price a forecast

title.zh: 期权收益与看涨–看跌平价

desc.zh: 看涨和看跌期权的到期收益是折线，可以相加；股票加看跌等于看涨加存款，所以 C − P = S − K·e^(−rT)。
desc.en: Call and put payoffs are kinked lines that add up; a share plus a put equals a call plus a deposit, so C − P = S − K·e^(−rT).

title.zh: 一步二叉树：复制与风险中性概率
title.en: One-step binomial: replication and risk-neutral probability

desc.zh: 股价只有涨跌两种结果时，若干股股票加一笔借款能复制期权，期权价格等于复制成本，与真实的上涨概率无关。
desc.en: When the share can only go up or down, some shares plus a loan replicate the option; its price is the cost of that portfolio and does not depend on the real probability of a rise.

zh: 为什么期权价格和涨跌概率无关
en: why option price does not depend on probability

title.zh: CRR 二叉树与美式期权
title.en: The CRR binomial tree and American options

desc.zh: 把时间切成很多步，从到期收益逐层往回算；每个结点比较继续持有和立即行权，就能给美式期权定价；步数增加时收敛到布莱克–斯科尔斯。
desc.en: Cut time into many steps and work back from the payoff; comparing holding with exercising at each node prices American options; the price converges to Black–Scholes as steps increase.

zh: 美式和欧式期权的区别
二叉树为什么收敛到布莱克斯科尔斯
en: how to price an American option

title.zh: 几何布朗运动与波动率

desc.zh: 股价的对数回报近似正态，标准差随时间的平方根增长；波动率 σ 是一年对数回报的标准差。
desc.en: Log returns are roughly normal with a standard deviation growing as the square root of time; volatility σ is the standard deviation of a year's log return.

title.zh: 布莱克–斯科尔斯公式与方程

desc.zh: C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂)：持有 N(d₁) 股股票、借一笔钱的成本；它也是一个与热传导方程同类的偏微分方程的解，可以用有限差分求解。
desc.en: C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂): the cost of holding N(d₁) shares against a loan; it also solves a partial differential equation of the heat-equation family, which finite differences can solve.

zh: 期权定价为什么不用预期收益率

title.zh: 希腊字母与 Delta 对冲

desc.zh: Delta、Gamma、Vega、Theta 是期权价值对股价、波动率和时间的敏感度；卖方按 Delta 持股并不断调整，盈亏只取决于真实波动率与定价波动率之差。
desc.en: Delta, gamma, vega and theta are the option's sensitivities to price, volatility and time; a seller who holds delta shares and rebalances ends with a P&L that depends only on realised against priced volatility.

title.zh: 隐含波动率、微笑与肥尾
title.en: Implied volatility, the smile and fat tails

desc.zh: 把市场价代回公式倒推出的波动率随行权价变化（微笑、偏斜），因为真实回报的大跌远比正态分布多，且波动会聚集。
desc.en: The volatility implied by market prices varies with strike (the smile, the skew), because large falls are far more common than the normal curve allows and volatility clusters.

zh: 布莱克斯科尔斯模型的缺陷

title.zh: 赫斯顿随机波动率模型

desc.zh: 让方差自己随机变动并与股价负相关，蒙特卡洛算出的期权价格就带有偏斜。
desc.en: Let the variance move randomly and correlate negatively with the share price, and Monte Carlo prices show a skew.

zh: 波动率偏斜是怎么来的
为什么低行权价的期权更贵
en: why is there a volatility skew

title.zh: 保证金、杠杆与中央清算

desc.zh: 期货每天按市价结清盈亏，保证金不足就被强平；清算所插在所有交易中间，把欠款多边轧差，也把风险集中到自己身上。
desc.en: Futures settle gains and losses daily and close out an account short of margin; a clearing house stands between all trades, nets what is owed and concentrates the risk in itself.

zh: 为什么看对了方向还会亏

title.zh: 套期保值、基差风险与名义本金
title.en: Hedging, basis risk and notional amounts

desc.zh: 对冲能去掉多少风险取决于期货与现货的相关性，最优比例 h* = ρσs/σf；名义本金远大于真正换手的总市值；监管数据显示绝大多数个人衍生品交易者是亏的。
desc.en: How much risk a hedge removes depends on the correlation between futures and spot, with best ratio h* = ρσs/σf; notional amounts dwarf the gross market value that changes hands; regulator data show most individual derivatives traders lose.

en: how big is the derivatives market
do retail option traders make money

title.zh: 衍生品市场的前沿（2026 年 11 月）

desc.zh: 当日到期期权、永续合约的资金费率、国债集中清算、LIBOR 换成 SOFR、深度对冲：每条事实带日期，分成已确立、已测量或演示、仍在争论。
desc.en: Zero-day options, perpetual futures and funding rates, Treasury clearing, LIBOR to SOFR, deep hedging: each fact dated and sorted into established, measured or demonstrated, and contested.

zh: 永续合约为什么没有到期日
